quote: Goncharov conjecture posed in 1995 in 'Geometry of configurations, polylogarithms, and motivic cohomology' published in Advances in Mathematics
note: Introduced in the paper 'Geometry of configurations, polylogarithms, and motivic cohomology', Advances in Mathematics, volume 114, number 2, pages 197–318 (1995). The conjecture extends earlier work by Don Zagier from 1991.
